title: Three-pair beta cache composed with straight-line production code

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.390000001 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins, with no heuristic: Chen-Stein on cross-node leaf pairs bounds P(no collision), and drops, caps, wrong class indices, label errors, the carry sites of section 3.4 and two meters' caps are charged failure rows (section 6, success.md). Every run's total work is at most 2^124.898572678358 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit; at most 286.9950 per leaf, certificate.py). Each pair of generator points X, Y gives six leaves x(phi^t(X) +- Y), t = 0, 1, 2, from one batched inverse of y_Y^2 - y_X^2: with a = x_X, b = x_Y, E = b^4 + 2a^3 b, F = a^4 + 2ab^3, G = 3a^2 b^2 and w = 1/(y_Y +- y_X)^2 they are (Ew - b) + beta^t (Fw - a) + beta^(2t) Gw, a discrete Fourier transform, and neither they nor the components Ew, Fw, Gw are formed: each component's two 128-bit fractions come from truncated products of the rows of E, F and G with w and beta w (sections 3.1, 3.3). A class's label is the top 100 bits of v*/p and (beta v* mod p)/p, v* = min(x, beta x, beta^2 x); a leaf's fractions are sums of its components' with correction words, within [-132, 194], [-132, 194] and [-389, 264] at 128 bits, and a leaf in the window set W or the label-error set D' (below 2^-58.47 and 2^-16.65 per leaf) is a charged missed collision; a lattice count bounds a box of label values at 1 + 2^-17 times its share (section 3.3). Machine and transport are those of sections 2.1 and 4: k-record block messages, every delivery charged as executed route.s code, links without state. Peak memory at most 2^135.9989 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^108.4542 units, included; no advice; certificate.py checks the declared figures. Credits: section 9 and the declared dependencies; no prior acceptance or score is a premise. An analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Run the leaf kernels on production points against exact arithmetic (fractions against a bit-exact model of bwd and their bounds, the truncated products' error terms, the Fourier identity, records against a model of keys, indices and labels outside W and D') and the class-rule and class-label tests; the emit, both hops (deliveries by executing dlv or dlvk) and the grouping on a 4 x 4 machine (machine.py); the sites and fixups of section 3.4 (sites.py); every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
